summary: Push clients, usage, machines, devices, native sessions and terminal inventories on the collections stream

replay.detail: Existing admission and recovery behavior is unchanged.

schema.detail: No database schema or projection version changes.

compatibility.detail: Optional inventory-collections capability version 1 admits six bounded v0 snapshot/changes collections. ConnectedClient and Usage resources are modeled by generated clients; older clients preserve unknown resources and older daemons remain detectable.

downtime.detail: Normal daemon binary replacement enables the new subscriptions.

manual.detail: Clients select the optional capability and retain existing reads on older members.

recovery.detail: Reconnecting subscriptions receive fresh authoritative snapshots.
